Team — read the redlines. Below is a recommended negotiating position that balances legal exposure and the customer’s request. Please treat as proposed language to send back to Acme (I’ll draft redline).

1) Cap mechanics: Redwood proposes a hybrid cap — the greater of (i) $4,000,000 and (ii) 12 months of fees paid to Redwood under the applicable Order Form during the 12 months preceding the event giving rise to liability. Rationale: keeps a simple floor while acknowledging Acme’s fee-based point.

2) Carve-outs: standard carve-outs remain for (a) gross negligence or willful misconduct, (b) breach of confidentiality and data security obligations, (c) IP indemnity obligations, and (d) fraud. These are unlimited (except for fraud where remedies are subject to equitable relief).

3) Termination refunds and wind-down: propose treating refunds for unused, prepaid fees as an obligation outside but subject to a defined limit: Redwood will refund prepaid, unused fees pro rata, but the aggregate refund liability shall not exceed the unused portion of prepaid fees attributable to the terminated services. For wind-down assistance (reasonable cooperation to transition services), Redwood will provide up to 30 hours of project management and assistance at no additional charge; any additional assistance will be charged at standard professional services rates and excluded from consequential damages.

4) Exclude explicit refunds/wind-down payments from being treated as consequential damages, but keep them within the direct-liability framework (i.e., they are direct contractual remedies rather than damages for lost profits).

5) Mutuality & negotiation wiggle room: suggest adding a mutuality clause so the cap/effects are symmetric for both parties. If Acme insists on a fully fee-based multiplier (e.g., 24 months), we can trade off with a narrower carve-out scope (e.g., exclude only IP/Data/Confidentiality, not termination refunds).

Next steps: Karthik / Laura — do you want me to produce a tracked-redline MSA that inserts the hybrid cap language and the wind-down assistance paragraph? I can also prepare a short memo justifying the compromise for Acme’s legal team.

Thanks,
Priyom Das
